summary: In bad(), the StringBuilder 'data' was unconditionally assigned null in both branches of the first if/else, then dereferenced via data.length() in the second if block, guaranteeing a NullPointerException. The fix initializes 'data' with a valid StringBuilder instance in both branches so that data.length() computes a real length (0 for the fresh builder) while preserving the feature of writing out the builder's length.
